traits.name: Deny Advantage
traits.text: The gang leader isn't flat-footed to creatures of 7th level or lower that are hidden, undetected, flanking, or using surprise attack.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.text: When the gang leader rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.text: On the first round of combat, if the gang leader rolls Deception or Stealth for initiative, creatures who haven't acted are flat-footed to the gang leader.

traits.name: Nimble Dodge
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The gang leader is targeted with an attack by an attacker they can see Effect The gang leader gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

traits.name: Brutal Rally
traits.text: ⬲ (auditory, emotion, linguistic, mental); Trigger The gang leader rolls a critical hit against a creature Effect All allies that can see the gang leader gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls until the start of the gang leader's next turn.

traits.name: Gang Up
traits.text: Any enemy is flat-footed against the gang leader's melee attacks due to flanking as long as the enemy is within melee reach of both the gang leader and one of the gang leader's allies.

traits.name: Quick Draw
traits.text: ⬻ The gang leader Interacts to draw a weapon, then Strikes with that weapon.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The gang leader deals an extra 2d6 (2d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ shortsword +18 (agile, magical, versatile s); Damage 1d6+10 (1d6+10) piercing

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ sling +18 (propulsive, range increment 50 feet, reload 1); Damage 1d6+8 (1d6+8) bludgeoning
